text.en: Whether you’re planning a family trip, running a rec league or hosting a potluck, coordinating as a group is easier when everyone can pitch in, build and decide together in one place.
text.th: Whether you’re planning a family trip, running a rec league or hosting a potluck, coordinating as a group is easier when everyone can pitch in, build and decide together in one place.

text.en: Today, we’re introducing Tabletop, a new Google Labs experiment built for real-time collaboration.
text.th: Today, we’re introducing Tabletop, a new Google Labs experiment built for real-time collaboration.

text.en: Just add in your links, files, and ideas, then prompt @tabletop — or pick a starter template — to generate custom interactive trip itineraries, dinner polls, expense splitters, and tournament brackets. Once your space is ready, drop the invite link in your group chat to let everyone jump in and use it at the same time, like in a Google Doc.

text.en: Tabletop is rolling out in the U.S. (18+) via waitlist. Pull up a chair and sign up at labs.google/tabletop.
